items.html: And behold, you know that the root of ZA is but six Sefirot, and that afterwards it grew and ten Sefirot came to be in it. And likewise Malchut: her root is a single point, and afterwards she became one comprising ten Sefirot. Thus at first their root is only seven kings alone: six in ZA and one in the Nukva. And these cling to the last two letters of the name, which are Vav-Hey, and these two letters are eleven in gematria. And these are the secret of the eleven spices of the incense: ten inner Sefirot and one surrounding. And although the surrounding one also comprises ten Sefirot, it is called one.
